title: DESIGN (deep pass 3): the work system answers 'is this still live?' in three unjoined places (pipeline item state, its target row's state, the lane session's status) - proposal to derive liveness from one join
note: [WEEKLY-AUDIT-2026-10-19 deep pass 3 DESIGN CRITICISM, session_014UeddhjFnc6fSA41bo5V65] Subsystem chosen: the follow-through system (pipeline + checklist) - most incidents this week. MEASURED 2026-10-21: 914 open pipeline items / 5836 records; 253 due (57 on 10-07, 63 on 10-14 by the same items); 62 due items routed to closed rows; 188 landed_unproven, 72 past due_by; >=6 of 14 in_flight rows had archived lanes. COHESION: an item's liveness = f(item.state, routed_to row.state, row.lane session status) and no code joins them, so each layer reports 'routed'/'in_flight'/'landed_unproven' after the thing it points at has ended. Soak verdicts have two graders (soak-state.json vs soak_state.py) that disagree (AUD-20261019-SOAK-ITEMS-LONG-EXIT). PHILOSOPHY: 'routed' and 'landed_unproven' are non-terminal states with no puller - the exact 'filing is a parking lot' failure CLAUDE.md names, rebuilt one level down. MECHANISM (if starting today): one liveness function used by --check, the brief and the Workflow page: item due if (own clock) OR (target row closed) OR (target row landed_unproven past due_by) OR (lane archived while in_flight); routed items inherit their target's closure. NOT MEASURED AT ALL: throughput - items closed per week vs filed per week; without it the treadmill is invisible until a sweep. DELETE: soak-state.json grader once pipeline reads the mechanical one; the 17 legacy-soak-contract items. TRADE-OFF: a derived due() makes section 0 larger on day one (~+130 items) before sweeps shrink it. Builds: AUD-20261019-ROUTED-TO-CLOSED-ROW, -LU-OBSERVATION-PULL, -STALE-INFLIGHT, -SOAK-ITEMS-LONG-EXIT; this row adds the throughput metric (closed/filed per week in pipeline --stats) and closes when those four are done. next_action ask_operator: whether section 0 should grow by derivation (recommended) or the sweeps run first.
